note: Wooded private campground on the north shore of Prairie Lake off County Road 49 north of Grand Rapids, with a swimming beach and raft, boat launch and docks, canoe and paddleboat rentals, a lodge with snack bar and a small playground. Some sites are let by the month or season. --Claude
